permit.applies: The worker applies at a Labour Department office (holding a valid passport and, if needed, a Belize visa); once the Labour Department approves, the permit is issued and paid for at the nearest Immigration Office.
permit.first: The Labour Department's approval of the application.

fees.what: Temporary Employment Permit, entertainer performing alone, one week or less
Temporary Employment Permit, entertainers in a group of two to five, one week or less
Temporary Employment Permit, entertainers in a group of six or more, one week or less
Temporary Employment Permit, professional worker (university degree), one year

sources.title: Immigration and Nationality Department (Belize), Temporary Employment Permit
sources.said: In order to submit a Temporary Employment Permit application with the Labour Department you must hold a valid passport and a valid Belize visa, if necessary. If your application is approved you must visit the nearest Immigration Office to the Labour Department office where you made your submission for the permit. … A. Professional Workers (Holders of University Degree) One Year $3000.00 … H. Entertainers performing in groups of two or more persons but whose group consists of less than six persons One Week or less $1000.00 I. Entertainers performing in groups of six persons or more One Week or less $1500.00 J. Entertainers performing alone One week or less $600.00 … Step 2: Notification of Application Status Within 30 days you will receive a call from the Labour Department to inform you on the status of your application.
